what_this_is: Entailment of every claim the URL-first arm (uncitable records excluded at retrieval) displayed on the frozen 134-question probe set, judged against the passage it cited. Model-judged, two blind passes plus adjudication, with a derangement control arm. NOT a clinician's judgement of clinical correctness.

provenance.arm: the URL-first arm (uncitable records excluded at retrieval)

judge.decoding: not set; harness defaults, so the passes are not bitwise reproducible
judge.model_checkpoint: NOT RECOVERABLE: no script pins a model, so each judge subagent inherited the session's model. Family is Anthropic Claude via Claude Code. See the configuration file; the paper states this as a limitation rather than naming a version it cannot prove.
